patch_description: This redesign replaces the single-point population annealer with a modular hybrid differential-evolution search. It uses a progressively decaying low-tail objective during global exploration, vectorized population scoring, elitist preservation, periodic local perturbation around the best configuration, and a final deterministic bottleneck-focused coordinate polish. The triangular-domain projection and Cartesian conversion are isolated into reusable helpers, making the optimization flow clearer and more robust.
